name: JIGSAWS: JHU-ISI Gesture and Skill Assessment Working Set
description: JIGSAWS (JHU-ISI Gesture and Skill Assessment Working Set) is a benchmark dataset for surgical gesture recognition, temporal segmentation, and robotic skill evaluation in robot-assisted surgery. Captured using the da Vinci Surgical System across eight surgeons of varying expertise, it contains 103 kinematic and stereo-video task trials performing three core surgical tasks: suturing, needle-passing, and knot-tying, annotated with fine-grained gesture transitions.
